import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    private static long gcd(long a, long b) {
        while (b != 0) {
            long t = a % b;
            a = b;
            b = t;
        }
        return a;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int a = sc.nextInt();
        int b = sc.nextInt();
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int x = 0, y = 0;
        double best = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
        long j = 1;
        while (j <= n) {
            long base = (j * a) / b;
            long i = base - 1;
            while (i <= base + 1) {
                double cur = Math.abs((double) i / (double) j - (double) a / (double) b);
                if (cur < best) {
                    best = cur;
                    x = (int) i;
                    y = (int) j;
                }
                ++i;
            }
            ++j;
        }
        long g = gcd(x, y);
        System.out.println((x / g) + "/" + (y / g));
        sc.close();
    }
}
